name: SoftmaxGradFront
note: Front variant of softmax backward with Tiling: y=rowsum(grad*x), producing only the per-row reduction (not the full grad*x-sum*x). Device-side SoftMaxTilingFunc builds the tiling inside the kernel. x=uniform softmax output 1/64, grad=const 2.0 -> y=2.0 per row. Output is reduce-shaped (scalar in col 0 of each 8-float block).
